scoring_justification: Headline tuning range is produced by a complex mode-matching solver; the agent submits only the final percentages, with no raw artifact that would allow recomputation without re-running the solver, and the lightweight checker cannot re-run the full simulation.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold tuning range values for the 94 GHz and 220 GHz designs.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper text: Section II.A states 'the range of electronically frequency tuning … is equal to 3%'; Section II.B states 'no gap operation frequency range about 7% at 220-GHz'.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted directly from the paper's reported results.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the actual published tuning ranges for the given grating geometries.

outputs.description: Electronic frequency tuning ranges (in percent) for the 94 GHz and 220 GHz three-stage grating clinotron designs.
